# DNS misconfiguration routing internal traffic to the internet

Requests to an internal service are unexpectedly slow and occasionally hit a public error page.

A wildcard CNAME in the public zone shadowed the internal record after a split-horizon DNS view was accidentally removed, so internal names resolved to public addresses.

1. Trace the resolution path and confirm the public CNAME is returned
2. Restore the split-horizon internal view for the affected zone
3. Remove or scope the offending wildcard record
4. Validate internal names resolve to internal IPs from client subnets

Error Details
```
dig internal-api.corp -> returns a public IP (CNAME to a parked domain); resolution path leaked to public resolver 8.8.8.8; no NXDOMAIN as expected
```

Tags: networking, dns, split-horizon, cname, misroute
